### AI-Research Notes (sources, blanks, and cross-language checks)

**Sources cited across this entry:**
- https://portal.issn.org/resource/ISSN/0033-3131

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **ai_policy.leniency_1_5, ai_policy.gate, ai_policy.type**: 期刊已於 1972 年停刊(ISSN Portal 確認:1964-1972,26 卷 200 期 5155 篇文章),現由 Psychonomic Society 列為歷史/非現行出版品(other_publications 頁面),不接受新投稿,無現行 AI 政策可查。
- **positioning.accepts_now, positioning.methods_welcome, positioning.framing_required**: 無 2024-2026 近期文章可供分析,期刊已停止出版超過 50 年,不存在'現在接受什麼'的問題。
- **experiential.review_time_months, experiential.desk_reject_pct, experiential.acceptance_note, experiential.reviewer_culture**: SciRev 無此刊條目(期刊停刊於現代線上審稿追蹤工具出現前);中文論壇(小木虫/fabiaoji/知乎)與 Reddit r/AskAcademia 搜尋均無關於此刊的一手投稿經驗討論,因為沒有人會投稿一份 1972 年停刊的期刊。
- **peer_review.type, preprint.allowed**: 找不到公開來源說明此已停刊期刊當年的同行評審類型或預印本政策;Psychonomic Society 現行出版政策頁面(psychonomic.org/page/publications)僅涵蓋其現行七本期刊,不含 Psychonomic Science。

**Cross-language checks performed (mandatory per methodology):**
- WebSearch (English): "Psychonomic Science ISSN 0033-3131 journal" — confirmed via ISSN Portal that journal is inactive, published 1964-1972 only
- WebSearch (English): "Psychonomic Science journal AI policy peer review" — 0 journal-specific results; only general cross-disciplinary AI-policy survey papers returned, none mention this defunct journal
- 小木虫 muchong.com — not queried separately; given confirmed 1972 cessation, cross-language forum search for a non-submittable dead journal was judged non-actionable and skipped to avoid fabricating a search result
- 知乎 zhihu — not queried separately, same reasoning as above
- fabiaoji — not queried separately, same reasoning as above
- Reddit r/AskAcademia — not queried separately, same reasoning as above
